package fixture

import (
	"fmt"
	"testing"
)

func TestPass(t *testing.T) {}

func TestFail(t *testing.T) {
	t.Error("boom")
}

func TestSkip(t *testing.T) {
	t.Skip("not here")
}

func TestParent(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("ok case", func(t *testing.T) {})
	t.Run("bad", func(t *testing.T) { t.Error("boom") })
	t.Run("skipped", func(t *testing.T) { t.Skip("not here") })
}

func TestNested(t *testing.T) {
	t.Run("outer", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Run("inner", func(t *testing.T) {})
	})
}

// Output without a trailing newline glues the result onto it in -v mode.
func TestUnterminatedOutput(t *testing.T) {
	fmt.Print("no newline")
}
